We should use the cmd_controller_execute tool.

We need to construct a command string. On Windows, to kill a process named timer.exe, we can use taskkill /IM timer.exe /F. Then to delete the file, we can use del /f /q path\to\timer.exe. But we don't know the path. Maybe it's in current directory. Use del /f /q timer.exe. So combined: taskkill /IM timer.exe /F && del /f /q timer.exe. That will kill the process and delete the file.
